mapper.insert: insert into fac_booking (tenant_id, id, fac_id, res_id, sid, aud, member_no, day, start_slot, slots, start_at, end_at, noshow_min, status, pay_mode, amount, pay_status, pass_id, note, by_staff, extra, purge_at, hold_until) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{fac}, #{res}, #{sid}, #{aud}, #{memberNo}, #{day}::date, #{slot}, #{slots}, to_timestamp(#{startAt}::bigint / 1000.0), to_timestamp(#{endAt}::bigint / 1000.0), #{noShowMin}::smallint, #{status}, #{payMode}, #{amount}, #{payStatus}, #{passId}, #{note}, #{byStaff}, #{extra}::jsonb, case when #{extra}::text is null then null else ((#{extra}::jsonb->>'purge_at')::date + time '00:00') at time zone 'Asia/Seoul' end, case when #{holdMin}::int > 0 then now() + make_interval(mins => #{holdMin}::int) end) on conflict (tenant_id, id) do nothing
mapper.select: select from fac_booking b where b.tenant_id = #{tid} and b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into fac_slot (tenant_id, fac_id, res_id, day, slot, seat, booking_id, sid, excl_group) values (#{tid}, #{fac}, #{res}, #{day}::date, #{slot}, #{seat}, #{bk}, #{sid}, #{excl}) on conflict (tenant_id, res_id, day, slot, seat) do nothing
mapper.delete: delete from fac_slot where tenant_id = #{tid} and booking_id = #{bk}
mapper.select: select res_id as "res", slot, count(*)::int as n from fac_slot where tenant_id = #{tid} and fac_id = #{fac} and day = #{day}::date group by res_id, slot
select count(*)::int from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and status in ('requested','approved','confirmed') and day >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
select day::text from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} and status = 'no_show' order by day

select from fac_booking b where b.tenant_id = #{tid} and b.sid = #{sid} and (b.day < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date or b.status not in ('requested','approved','confirmed','checked_in')) b.day >= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date and b.status in ('requested','approved','confirmed','checked_in') order by b.day desc, b.start_slot limit 100
select , (b.hold_until < now()) as "holdOver" from fac_booking b where b.tenant_id = #{tid} and b.fac_id = #{fac} and b.day = #{day}::date and b.status in ('approved','confirmed') limit 200

select distinct fac_id as fac, day::text as day from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and status in ('approved','confirmed') and day between (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date - 1 and (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
select from fac_booking b where b.tenant_id = #{tid} and b.fac_id = #{fac} and b.day between #{from}::date and #{to}::date and b.status in ('requested','approved','confirmed')
mapper.insert: insert into fac_pass (tenant_id, id, sid, aud, product_id, fac_id, kind, total, starts_on, ends_on, status, amount, cls_id) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{sid}, #{aud}, #{product}, #{fac}, #{kind}, #{total}, #{starts}::date, #{ends}::date, #{status}, #{amount}, #{cls}) on conflict (tenant_id, id) do nothing
mapper.select: select id, sid, product_id as "productId", fac_id as "facId", kind, total, used, starts_on::text as "startsOn", ends_on::text as "endsOn", status, pay_id as "payId" from fac_pass where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}

select id, product_id as "productId", fac_id as "facId", kind, total, used, greatest(total - used, 0) as "left", starts_on::text as "startsOn", ends_on::text as "endsOn", status from fac_pass where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} order by created_at desc limit 50
mapper.update: update fac_pass set used = used + 1 where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id} and status = 'active' and (kind = 'period' or used < total)
update fac_pass set used = greatest(used - 1, 0) where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
update fac_pass set total = greatest(total + #{delta}, used) where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
update fac_pass set status = #{status}, pay_id = coalesce(#{payId}, pay_id) where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
update fac_pass set ends_on = ends_on + #{days}::int where tenant_id = #{tid} and fac_id = #{fac} and kind = 'period' and status = 'active' and ends_on >= #{from}::date and starts_on <= #{to}::date
mapper.insert: insert into fac_checkin (tenant_id, booking_id, pass_id, rental_id, sid, fac_id, day, via, by_staff, token_jti) values (#{tid}, #{bk}, #{pass}, #{rental}, #{sid}, #{fac}, #{day}::date, #{via}, #{by}, #{jti})
mapper.select: select count(*)::int from fac_checkin where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
mapper.insert: insert into fac_rental (tenant_id, id, sid, aud, fac_id, res_id, product_id, from_day, due_day, deposit, deposit_status, amount, status, pay_mode, pay_status) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{sid}, #{aud}, #{fac}, #{res}, #{product}, #{from}::date, #{due}::date, #{deposit}, coalesce(#{depStatus}, 'none'), #{amount}, #{status}, #{payMode}, #{payStatus}) on conflict (tenant_id, id) do nothing
mapper.sql: id, sid, fac_id as "facId", res_id as "resId", product_id as "productId", from_day::text as "fromDay", due_day::text as "dueDay", deposit, deposit_status as "depositStatus", late_fee as "lateFee", amount, status, condition_note as "condition", to_char(returned_at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', ) as "returnedAt"
mapper.select: select from fac_rental where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
select from fac_rental where tenant_id = #{tid} and sid = #{sid} order by created_at desc limit 50
select res_id from fac_rental where tenant_id = #{tid} and fac_id = #{fac} and status in ('approved','lent','overdue')
mapper.update: update fac_rental set status = #{status}, late_fee = coalesce(#{lateFee}, late_fee), deposit_status = coalesce(#{depStatus}, deposit_status), condition_note = coalesce(#{note}, condition_note), returned_at = case when #{status} = 'returned' then now() else returned_at end where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
update fac_rental set status = 'overdue' where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'lent' and due_day < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
mapper.insert: insert into fac_payment (tenant_id, id, booking_id, pass_id, rental_id, method, amount, list_amount, toss_order_id, receipt_no, recorded_by, note, status) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{bk}, #{pass}, #{rental}, #{method}, #{amount}, coalesce(#{list}::int, 0), #{order}, #{receipt}, #{by}, #{note}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, booking_id as "bookingId", pass_id as "passId", rental_id as "rentalId", method, amount, list_amount as "listAmount", toss_key as "tossKey", toss_order_id as "orderId", status, receipt_no as "receiptNo" from fac_payment where tenant_id = #{tid} and (id = #{id} or toss_order_id = #{id})

select id, method, amount, status, toss_key as "tossKey", toss_order_id as "orderId" from fac_payment where tenant_id = #{tid} and (booking_id = #{ref} or pass_id = #{ref} or rental_id = #{ref}) order by at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update fac_payment set status = #{status}, toss_key = coalesce(#{key}, toss_key), at = now() where tenant_id = #{tid} and id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into fac_refund (tenant_id, id, payment_id, target, rule_type, calc, auto_amount, amount, edit_reason, by_staff, toss_cancel_key, status) values (#{tid}, #{id}, #{payment}, #{target}, #{rule}, #{calc}::jsonb, #{auto}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{by}, #{cancelKey}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, payment_id as "paymentId", target, rule_type as "rule", calc::text as calc, auto_amount as "auto", amount, edit_reason as "editReason", by_staff as "by", status, to_char(at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul', ) as at from fac_refund where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = #{status} order by at desc limit 200

select (select count(*)::int from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'requested') as "pendingApprovals", (select count(*)::int from fac_rental where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'lent' and due_day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date) as "dueReturns", (select count(*)::int from fac_rental where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'overdue') as overdue, (select count(*)::int from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and status = 'no_show' and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date) as "noShow", (select count(*)::int from fac_booking where tenant_id = #{tid} and day = (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date and status in ('approved','confirmed','checked_in','done')) as "todayBookings"

select b.fac_id as fac, count(*)::int as bookings, count(*) filter (where b.status = 'no_show')::int as "noShow", count(*) filter (where b.status in ('checked_in','done') or exists (select 1 from fac_checkin c where c.tenant_id = b.tenant_id and c.booking_id = b.id))::int as used, coalesce(sum(b.slots) filter (where b.status in ('confirmed','checked_in','done')), 0)::int as "slotsUsed" from fac_booking b where b.tenant_id = #{tid} and b.day between #{from}::date and #{to}::date group by b.fac_id order by b.fac_id

select coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where status = 'paid' and method = 'toss'), 0)::int as online, coalesce(sum(amount) filter (where status = 'paid' and method in ('card_onsite','cash','bank')), 0)::int as onsite, (select coalesce(sum(r.amount), 0)::int from fac_refund r where r.tenant_id = #{tid} and (r.at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date) as refunds from fac_payment where tenant_id = #{tid} and (at at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date between #{from}::date and #{to}::date
